issue.title: Remove the apispec <6.7.0 dependency ceiling
issue.body: Superset currently pins apispec below 6.7.0 because that release broke a unit test. Reproduce the failure on the latest compatible apispec release, update the affected OpenAPI schema code or test without weakening assertions, regenerate requirement locks, and run the targeted API/OpenAPI tests. Acceptance criteria: the upper bound is removed or advanced with a documented compatibility rationale; regression coverage passes; unrelated dependencies are unchanged.
